reviews.body:
No blockers; this can merge as far as I am concerned.

The handoff now derives its record-file list from the files actually present, while preserving the existing completed-turn and running-turn output. I checked the record writer, manager and turn-path callers, the originating history, backward compatibility of the rendered paths, and that the tests add failed, cancelled, and missing-record coverage without weakening the completed-turn assertions.

Repository coverage: I checked AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and CONTEXT-MAP.md/CONTEXT.md constraints, the full diff, callers, history, compatibility, test integrity, and the relevant runtime architecture boundary. No dependency or repository-asset changes are present.

Verification: `uv run pytest tests/test_subagent_handoff.py tests/test_subagent_direct_chat.py tests/test_subagent_manager.py -x` passed (386 tests); `git diff --check github/main...HEAD` and `uv run python scripts/check_source_language.py github/main...HEAD` passed. The initial test setup lacked the optional `raven_everos` workspace package; after syncing `everos-memory` through `uv`, the unmodified test command passed.
